title: 3964. Minimum Lights to Illuminate a Road

examples.explanation: One optimal placement is: Install an additional bulb at position 1, illuminating positions [0, 1, 2]. Install an additional bulb at position 3, illuminating positions [2, 3]. Therefore, the minimum number of additional bulbs required is 2.

Since lights[3] = 2, the working bulb at position 3 illuminates positions [1, 2, 3, 4]. Installing an additional bulb at position 1 illuminates positions [0, 1, 2], making every position visible. Therefore, the minimum number of additional bulbs required is 1.

hints: First mark all positions already visible from the existing working bulbs.
Then scan the road from left to right. Whenever you find the first invisible position i, install a new bulb as far right as possible while still covering i.
Since each additional bulb covers distance 1, the best position is usually i + 1, unless it goes out of bounds. After placing it, skip all positions it covers.
